Efetuar correção de defeitos apontados no processo de testes da solução, de média e baixa complexidade, a fim de atender aos processos de qualidade de software. review_candidates.title: Software Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today. Role Overview As a software engineer on Benchling's Infrastructure team, you will design, build, and operate the platforms, services, and tooling that let every Benchling engineering team ship and run software reliably, securely, and cost-effectively. Our work spans the foundations of our AWS environment: compute (Kubernetes/EKS), networking, secrets and identity, observability, infrastructure-as-code, and the economics of running all of it at scale. We hire software engineers for this team because strong programming, systems design, and problem-solving skills are the most durable foundation for infrastructure impact. You will independently scope and own meaningful, multi-quarter pieces of our platform end to end, from an ambiguous starting point to a production rollout and operational handoff, building paved roads that make the secure, reliable, and efficient path the default for engineers across Benchling. Responsibilities Own projects end-to-end, from initial design and tech plan, to prototype, to production rollout and operational handoff. Design, build, and maintain internal applications, APIs, automation, and tooling (CLIs, Slack apps, serverless services, and AI-powered assistants) that support Benchling's cloud platform and infrastructure workflows. Own parts of our AWS foundation, including Kubernetes (EKS), networking, secrets and PKI, and the security and observability capabilities around them, with clear SLOs, runbooks, and actionable telemetry. Advance our infrastructure-as-code practices at scale: operate and improve our Terraform Cloud release system, reusable Terraform modules, and the tooling around them, with policy-as-code guardrails that let service teams self-serve safely. Drive cloud cost governance as an engineering discipline: build cost visibility and anomaly alerting, allocate shared platform costs to the services that drive them, analyze usage trends. Contribute to observability tooling, vendor relationships, and the cost and performance tradeoffs of our monitoring stack. Make architectural decisions that other teams build on, drive alignment across multiple teams, and help set technical direction and standards for the areas you own. Operate and improve production systems, including on-call, incident response, blameless postmortems, and root-cause analysis, and use what you learn to reduce toil. Partner with engineers across Benchling to understand internal customer needs, mentor teammates through design reviews and tech plan feedback, and help mature our tooling, best practices, and engineering processes. Check out our engineering blog for examples of past work. How We Run Terraform At Scale: how we operate Terraform Cloud across hundreds of workspaces and the custom tooling we built around it. Building an LLM-Powered Slackbot: how we built a knowledge base on Amazon Bedrock that answers developer questions in Slack. Qualifications 8+ years of experience in software engineering, site reliability, platform, or infrastructure engineering Have strong software engineering fundamentals (coding, testing, debugging, API and system design) and proficiency in at least one general-purpose language such as Python, Go, or TypeScript Have hands-on experience with AWS (for example EC2, EKS, RDS, VPC, IAM, S3) and understand how compute, storage, networking, and security fit together Have production experience with infrastructure-as-code, ideally Terraform at meaningful scale Have working knowledge of Kubernetes and container-based platforms Have a track record of independently scoping and delivering complex, ambiguous, multi-month projects from proposal to production, including writing technical design documents and communicating tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders Have made architectural decisions that other engineers and teams build on, and driven alignment across multiple teams Are comfortable working across development and operations, including diagnosing hard production problems under pressure and participating in an on-call rotation Communicate clearly in writing, document your work well, and enjoy collaborating with internal platform users Nice to have Experience with cloud cost management (cost allocation, tagging strategies, commitment purchasing, unit economics) Experience with secrets and PKI infrastructure such as HashiCorp Vault Experience with AWS networking at scale (VPC design, Transit Gateway, multi-region connectivity) Experience building internal developer tooling such as CLIs, bots, or serverless services, including LLM-powered tools (for example retrieval-augmented generation on Amazon Bedrock) Experience with observability platforms and managing vendor relationships for engineering tooling Experience operating infrastructure in regulated (for example GxP) or multi-region environments Experience with GitOps and policy-as-code approaches to infrastructure change management Experience as a technical lead or mentor Experience using AI-assisted development tools to accelerate engineering and operational work How We Work We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday). #BI-Hybrid Benchling welcomes everyone. We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Compensation Range: $195K - $265K

review_candidates.description: SOVOS Pre-Sales Engineer (French Speaker) Sales Engineering·Full-Time·United Kingdom Build Your Future With Us The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to manage increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive. AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change. Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here. The Role At Sovos, we're transforming how businesses manage complex global compliance. This Pre-Sales Engineer role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical advisory, supporting multi-country sales engagements across our tax and compliance technology portfolio. You'll act as a trusted advisor to enterprise customers, leading discovery, designing scalable solutions, and positioning the business value of our platform. Design scalable, cross-border solution architectures aligned to business and compliance needs, positioning commercial value alongside technical functionality. Experience navigating ERP ecosystems is highly desirable; exposure to tax, compliance, regulatory, finance or adjacent domains is advantageous. You're comfortable operating autonomously with appropriate support with limited regional infrastructure, working effectively across time zones and global teams. You have strong written and verbal communication skills in English and French, and you're willing to travel occasionally. Comfort with AI-assisted workflows and tools that enhance pre-sales efficiency and personalisation is a plus. Global Mentoring Programs AI Tools and Technology from Day 1 Continuous Learning and Development Language Learning Support Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs Global Parental Leave Policy 30 days holiday plus bank holidays Private Health Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Coverage Life Insurance Critical Illness Cover Income Protection Pension with employer contribution Employee Assistance Programme Equal Opportunity Employer Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to contribute authentically and be valued for their unique perspectives and backgrounds. Company Background Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries. More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com. Define technical designs and contribute to architecture, technical roadmaps, system diagrams, and engineering standards for coding, testing, and documentation. Build and integrate application programming interfaces (APIs), services, and data pipelines across distributed systems, including integrations with enterprise resource planning (ERP), financial systems, payment platforms, and third-party services. Contribute to microservices and event-driven architecture, and support continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), deployment checklists, log reviews, and DevOps practices. Lead and contribute to production issue resolution, root cause analysis, and corrective actions, while supporting platform upgrades, modernization, cloud adoption, and technology optimization.
